market.conclusion: The market is not falling hard, but tech is clearly losing ground. QQQ is below its 50-day average and only 25% of stocks are above theirs. That is a poor setting for new short-term trades, so every swing call here is Wait or Avoid. Long-term buying of quality at good prices can go on, slowly.
arguments: Macro: tech is sideways and fear is normal (VIX 17.49), so there's no tailwind and no headwind. I agree, but weak breadth and tech lagging every other sector make me more cautious than 'neutral'.
Technical: QQQ is making lower highs and lower lows and has lagged SPY by 3.6 points over 20 sessions. I weight this most heavily for swing calls.
Rates: the 10-year yield fell 0.36 points in 4 weeks, which eases pressure on expensive tech. It's a real but mild offset, not enough to turn the trend.
Quant: no signal is validated. The tool has 227 forecasts recorded and none scored yet, so I give its signals no weight.
Conditions: GREEN, with 4 of 5 checks passing, but the measure is experimental and restricts nothing. I give it little weight.
market.change_mind: A QQQ close above $707.23 together with better breadth would reopen swing entries. A QQQ close below $659.74 would make me more defensive, even on long-term buys.

deep_dive.case_for: It's a grade A business with revenue up 83.38% over 12 months and a forward P/E of 10.32. At $166.19 it sits below its whole value range ($195.92–$411.04), which is why the long-term rule says Buy now.
deep_dive.case_against: The stock fell 23.5% in 20 sessions and is in a clear downtrend. Confirmed headlines report that Jensen Huang has resigned. The operating margin of 65% is at the top of its 5-year range, unpaid customer bills grew faster than sales, and insiders sold $946.6M outside pre-set plans. Earnings on 2026-11-17 can move the price sharply either way.
deep_dive.decides: The 2026-11-17 report and what it shows about the business after the leadership change. Until then, any long-term position should start small and grow gradually.
